hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels validates each reservation entry against available quantity individually. A cart with OVS-PIECE x6 and OVS-TWOPACK x3 needs 6+6=12 units of WIDGET with only 10 in stock, but each entry (6 <= 10) passes alone, so the order is created with 12 units reserved, oversold.
submitted_scenario:
schema: oversold.scenario/v1
name: per-line-sum-oversell
description: One cart has two lines sharing the WIDGET item whose combined need exceeds stock, though each line alone fits.
target:
  engine: medusa
  version: 2.22.0
  servers: 1
stock:
  WIDGET: 10
carts:
  big:
    server: 1
    lines:
    - sku: OVS-PIECE
      qty: 6
    - sku: OVS-TWOPACK
      qty: 3
race:
- id: big-completes
  server: 1
  do: complete
  cart: big
timing:
  release: together
runs: 3
seed: 1

hypothesis: The default locking provider is in-memory, so the lock around reservation creation only serializes within one process. Two servers completing different carts for the single SOLO unit at once can both read availability 1 and both reserve, overselling and/or losing a reserved counter update.
